messages:
alexa-docs: Hey all — I opened a tiny PR to harmonize export examples across SDK docs and to add a short Ruby snippet showing safe listing of evidence exports. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/790 :wave:

pranav-compliance: Thanks. Two compliance items: (1) examples should use `actor_id` and (2) retention defaults must be explicit (hosted=90d).

alexa-docs: I used `actor_id` and added a retention table (hosted 90d, dedicated 365d, private: configurable). Also I replaced full URIs with placeholders `REDACTED_EVIDENCE_URI`.

omar-eng: Quick SDK note: show pagination and avoid printing `evidence_ref`. For Ruby use Enumerator with page_size:50 and show logging of `export.id` only. Example sketch:

```ruby
exports = client.list_exports(page_size: 50)
exports.each do |ex|
  # safe to log id only, avoid evidence_ref
  puts ex.id
end
```

mel-legal: Agree with placeholders. Also change any \"should be encrypted\" phrasing to \"must be encrypted at rest and in transit\" for SOC2 tone. Add a one-line sanitized/unsanitized example.

alexa-docs: Added sanitized example to PR:
Unsanitized: {"evidence_ref":"s3://customer-bucket/ev-2026-02-01?X-Amz-Credential=..."}
Sanitized:   {"evidence_ref":"REDACTED_EVIDENCE_URI"}

pranav-compliance: Please also include a short migration note: if you previously used `export_uri` or embedded creds, run the internal sanitize tool prior to publishing export metadata. Footnote: key rotation recommended every 90 days for high-sensitivity exports.

alexa-docs: Added migration note and footnote on rotation. Also added a short internal-only CLI example (marked as internal): `./tools/sanitize-exports --dry-run` with sample output line.

omar-eng: One tweak to the Ruby snippet: show handling of next_page_token for clarity. Otherwise LGTM from eng.

ci-bot: docs CI passed for PR #790 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/790/commits/def456).

mel-legal: Legal approves wording and placeholders.

pranav-compliance: Compliance approved after \"must\" language and rotation note were added.

alexa-docs: Great — merging after docs lint check. Will include changelog entry: "clarify evidence export redaction; add SDK pagination examples (Ruby)".

ci-bot: docs linter OK.

alexa-docs: Merged and released as patch 1.12.3. Thanks team! :tada:
